note: Anti-drift rule D2 says: reachable or removed. Nothing ships to the site root without a registry entry and a nav entry. This file is the ONLY sanctioned exception list, and scripts/selftest.mjs fails if any root .html is in neither tools.json nor here. Its purpose is to convert an accident into a recorded decision: a page nobody can reach is dead weight that looks like progress, and the way that happens is by nobody noticing. An entry here is a debt with an owner, not an excuse — and a stale entry (a page that IS now registered) also fails, so the list cannot rot.

exceptions.detail: The landing page itself. It is the surface that renders the registry, so it cannot be an entry in it.

Shipped, reachable only by direct URL, and absent from both the landing page and the rail. It already satisfies the shared-shell contract (rldata -> rlapp -> rlnav, plus rlg/rlchart/rlticker) and belongs to the Market Structure group, so no new adapter module is required — market-structure.js already covers this domain. Registration is blocked on work, not policy: a tool entry, a simple-model definition, two journey definitions, and a Tier-A owner read, because this product's contract is that the brief covers EVERY registered tool. Registering it without that read would either break the coverage assertion or publish a permanently 'unavailable' card.

Registration is withheld by POLICY, not oversight. tool-experience.config.json dependencyGates.FEATURE008 withholds the private-portfolio-overlay and portfolio-stress-journey capabilities until specs/008-portfolio-survival-and-brief-lab reaches done with its three required milestones; that spec is not started. The page also loads only rlcontracts.js + rlportfolio.js, so it does not yet satisfy the shared-shell contract every registered tool must meet. Registering it now would either bypass a ratified gate or ship a tool that fails the shell assertions.
